pipeline.modality: Catheter lock solution (taurolidine 13.5 mg/mL + heparin 1,000 U/mL)

indications.indication: Prophylaxis of invasive fungal disease in adults undergoing allogeneic blood and marrow transplantation (BMT)
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 multicenter randomized double-blind trial of once-weekly rezafungin vs. standard antimicrobial regimen for IFD prophylaxis in allo-BMT (400 mg loading then 200 mg weekly x13)
indications.trial_status: Ongoing per 10-K (Mundipharma-sponsored; CorMedix holds US commercial rights)
